title: YouTube is rolling out an update to include "co-views", or the estimated number of people watching together on TV, in the public view counts for videos (Emma Roth/The Verge)
summary: Emma Roth / The Verge: YouTube is rolling out an update to include “co-views”, or the estimated number of people watching together on TV, in the public view counts for videos — YouTube view counts will now include estimates of how many people are watching a video together on TV.
